mechanism: The honeytoken is forwarded inside a request shaped as an ordinary release heartbeat (benign path, channel and user-agent), still to the loopback canary, to test whether a destination- or shape-based egress filter is bypassed.
notes: The heartbeat goes to /telemetry/heartbeat on the same loopback host and port, not /collect, so the canary must accept any path and record the body. The marker is in the client_id field. The destination is always 127.0.0.1; a destination-only filter has nothing to block here by design.
